environmentSpatialScope: The site is compared with the bounding extent of the published contour geometries. This does not determine the site’s noise level, absence of overflights or La. Published contour values are not site values.
environmentCatalogScope: Catalog metadata only. The site has not been checked against a noise contour; no noise level can be derived.
environmentScopeHint: A source-backed survey of the existing surroundings, not a noise calculation or approval. Map footprints describe existing buildings, not the planned development. No result establishes the absence of noise or an external noise level La.
environmentNoSurvey: No environmental check has been saved for this project.
environmentAviationHint: Airport proximity alone is insufficient. Inspect the actual noise-map layer, reference year and metric at the project site before assessing aircraft noise.
sourceDocumentScope: Saved text blocks only: no semantic interpretation or approval. Grid positions and byte offsets refer to extracted text, not physical drawing geometry. Text-to-layer associations are unknown.
sourceDocumentLayersDetected: PDF layers detected; default display visibility is preserved. Print visibility may differ.
sourceDocumentLayersNone: The PDF contains no optional-content layers.
sourceDocumentLayersUnavailable: Layer information is unavailable. This does not establish that the PDF has no layers.
sourceDocumentNoBlocks: No prepared text blocks on this page.
sourceDocumentPrepareHint: Prepare existing saved text once, without re-extraction or paid model calls.
budgetPendingReservations: Waiting for other paid calls to release their reservations.
budgetSpendAllowance: The spend allowance cannot cover another paid call.
budgetRetryAllowance: The automatic retry allowance is exhausted.
budgetUnknownUsage: Previous usage is unknown; reconcile it before another paid call.
budgetUnpricedCall: The call cannot be priced safely; check model pricing before continuing.
budgetWaitExpired: The bounded wait for budget capacity expired.
budgetNestedReservation: A nested call cannot wait while its parent holds a reservation.
budgetNotDispatched: No new paid call has been dispatched.
sourcePurposeHint: Applies to all revisions. Reference and comparison reports stay readable but are excluded from agent evidence. Start a fresh report after changing this; earlier results are not rewritten.
sourceReferenceReport: Reference report · Preserved as an example, not used as project evidence. Report generation uses the built-in structure, not this document’s findings.
sourceComparisonOnly: Test comparison · Preserved for evaluating the finished report. This document is excluded from agent retrieval and report generation.
affinityNoReadyPdf: This file has no ready PDF revisions. Choose another file or upload a PDF in Sources.
affinityConfirmExport: I confirm this PDF is the full export matching the selected original revision. This does not approve its content.
affinityAddPdfEvidence: Add linked PDF as agent evidence
agentSuggestDefaultHint: Jev checks on send. Team and Report need Apply, then Send. Unclear requests use Chat.
workflowProposalRoutingHint: Describe the outcome you need. Jev suggests a workflow in chat; calculations, reports and team work start only after confirmation.
workflowProposalCalculationDescription: Check the project inputs and calculate exterior-noise insulation room by room. You receive a calculation sheet with results and open inputs—not a full concept report. Specialist approval remains separate.
workflowProposalReportDescription: Prepare the selected concept or review from project evidence, including supported calculations, findings and narrative. Missing inputs are clarified first; specialist approval remains separate.
workflowProposalTeamDescription: Delegate the question to specialists and combine their findings in chat. No full report is commissioned.
workflowProposalChatDescription: Answer or explain the request in this conversation, without starting the calculation, report or specialist-team workflow.
workflowProposalUncertain: I couldn't confidently choose a workflow. Choose the outcome below, or cancel and clarify your request in chat. Nothing has started.
workflowProposalSources: {count} selected source versions; otherwise current project evidence is used for calculations and reports.
workflowProposalCostHint: AI source reading and writing use this allowance. It is a spending limit, not a quote. Deterministic arithmetic itself needs no model call.
workflowProposalUnavailable: This workflow proposal is unavailable in this conversation.
agentCalculationScope: Calculation sheet only · Exterior noise. No report writing; inputs and results still require specialist review.
acousticScenarioScope: Exact saved source versions. Exterior-noise arithmetic only; no automatic adoption of new uploads or rule changes.
acousticScenarioNeedsReview: Review the inputs and results, then approve the latest revision to use it as a scenario basis. A scenario never inherits approval.
acousticScenarioNoModel: No AI calls or source extraction. Changes are recorded as unreviewed assumptions; the original stays unchanged. Geometry and applicability checks still apply.
acousticScenarioMissing: This room has no complete input record. Missing inputs cannot be filled by numeric adjustments; resolve them in the source evidence first.
agentSuggestionUnavailable: No clear recommendation is available. Choose a mode or continue with your current mode.
agentSteeringMode: Steering the active team run. Mode changes and suggestions are locked until it finishes.
agentTeamUnavailable: Team, Report and Calculation require enabled supervisor execution. Chat is available.
agentReportAutomaticEvidence: Project evidence is selected automatically; reference reports are excluded.
rolePermissionsHint: Changes apply to everyone assigned this role on their next request. Manage workspace access also allows changing roles and shared settings. At least one active administrator must remain.
knowledgeCategoryHint: Categories organize company knowledge without changing its content, review status or agent assignments.
knowledgeBulkApproveHint: Confirm that you have reviewed these entries and their sources. Each approval is recorded separately. Already approved entries are skipped. This does not assign agent profiles or certify engineering calculations.
knowledgeSearchPermission: Asking knowledge requires permission to run agents. You can still browse entries and your saved searches.
knowledgeSearchUnconfigured: Set up an AI provider and a low-complexity model preset in Settings to ask questions.
knowledgeQuestionExample: Where can we reduce construction costs without weakening fire protection?
knowledgeSearchFailed: This search failed or was interrupted. No automatic retry. Submit a new search to try again.
knowledgeNoEvidence: No supported answer was found in the matching excerpts. Try different wording or broaden the category and status filters.
knowledgeCitationHint: Quotes and review badges reflect the search-time snapshot. Exact quotes do not certify the AI's interpretation; open the entry to check current content and caveats.
knowledgeTurnLimit: This conversation has reached 20 turns. Start a new conversation to continue.
companyKnowledgeEmpty: No company knowledge matches these filters.
companyKnowledgeProvenance: Check the source references and caveats in the text. Text references are not linked original files or file revisions.
companyKnowledgeApprovalHint: Approve only after checking the content and its sources. Approval makes this entry eligible for agent profiles; it does not assign it automatically or certify an engineering calculation.
companyKnowledgeReadOnly: You can read this entry. Approval requires knowledge review permission.
agentMessageDelivered: Delivered · available at the next agent step
componentPdfUploadHint: Upload the PDF matching this source revision. Checksum and page count are verified.
componentFingerprintHint: This source has no PDF fingerprint. Open the supplier link, or import a new JSON revision with a PDF checksum and page count to attach a saved document.
componentPdfUploadFailed: The PDF could not be attached.
componentPdfAttached: Matching PDF attached. Catalog review is unchanged.
componentPdfReviewUnchanged: Attaching a matching PDF changes availability only, not catalog review. Supplier links are never fetched automatically.
componentPdfFallback: If your browser cannot display the PDF, use Open saved PDF above.
componentPropPlateMass: Typical precast plate mass per area
componentCatalogHint: Supplier specifications and source evidence. Review before agent use.
componentEmpty: No components match. Import starter data or change the filters. Missing records do not imply that no suitable product exists.
componentImportHint: Loads four source-backed starter records idempotently. For updates, download the current revision, edit its data and import the JSON with its expectedRevisionId unchanged.
componentImportSuccess: Import completed. Existing identical starter records are not duplicated.
componentUnknownCommercial: No quote, lead time or installation productivity is supplied. Prefabrication describes the element, not necessarily the finished assembly.
componentNoWarnings: No warnings recorded. This is not evidence of suitability or compliance.
componentReviewHint: Review means catalog checking only, not engineering, compliance or procurement approval. Only reviewed revisions may support recommendations. Check sources, units, conditions and warnings before deciding.
componentHistoricalReview: You are viewing an immutable historical revision. Return to the current revision to record a review.
componentReviewPermission: You do not have permission to review catalog records.
decisionRoutingSummarySelected: Selected-source summary workflow chosen; review remains required.
decisionRoutingPlannerRetained: Normal supervisor planning retained after routing check.
decisionRoutingBehavior: Off sends no routing context. Shadow sends bounded request and conversation context to TypeSafe but keeps the planner. Enabled skips planning only for eligible summaries of selected sources; reviews remain unchanged.
decisionRoutingEvaluation: The default threshold of 0.99 is uncalibrated. Evaluate routing in Shadow mode before enabling it. A TypeSafe credential is required, from a personal override, workspace override or server configuration.
decisionRoutingInvalid: Choose a routing mode and a confidence threshold between 0.9 and 1.
typesafeDataHandling: Jev by TypeSafe is an optional decision router and knowledge ranker, not a generative provider. Shadow and Enabled routing send bounded request and conversation context to TypeSafe. Shadow keeps the planner; Enabled skips planning only for eligible summaries of selected sources, with reviews unchanged. Saving a connection enables neither routing nor knowledge ranking. Optional personal and workspace API key overrides are encrypted and never shown. The server key cannot be removed through this form; removing an override falls back to the next available credential.
credentialPrecedence: Credential precedence: personal → workspace → server. Server credentials are never shown and cannot be removed here; this form manages optional encrypted personal and workspace overrides.
knowledgeRerankingHint: Optional and off by default, independent of routing. Sends bounded approved company knowledge excerpts to TypeSafe to rank relevance. Approvals and sources remain unchanged. Uses a deterministic fallback if ranking is unavailable; may add latency and cost.
reloadForUpdates: Reload the app to update. Save any unsaved changes first.
moduleLoadFailed: Part of this page could not load. The app may have been updated, or the connection was interrupted.
pageRenderFailed: This page encountered an unexpected error. Try reloading. If it happens again, contact your team administrator.
reloadCopyDraft: Copy any unsent text or unsaved changes before reloading. Nothing will reload automatically.
reloadConfirm: Reload Richtfest now? Unsent text and unsaved changes may be lost. Cancel to copy them first.
pageNotFoundHint: Check the address or return to a known Richtfest page.
locationSetupHint: Load official building context in Berlin or Rheinland-Pfalz from an exact house address. Trees and on-demand LiDAR are available only within Berlin source coverage. No geometry is inferred from meeting notes.
addressSearchPlaceholder: Search street, house number and city…
addressSelectRequired: Select a suggestion or enter the address manually before saving.
addressNoResults: No complete address found. Try a house number and city, or enter it manually.
addressSearchFailed: Address search is unavailable. Try again or enter the address manually.
addressSearchUnconfigured: Address search is not configured yet. You can enter the address manually.
locationAddressMissing: Add a street, house number and city in project details to load the site. Existing scene coordinates remain unchanged.
locationAddressChanged: The saved scene belongs to a different address, not this project's current site. It is preserved and hidden by default.
locationRlpCoverage: Rheinland-Pfalz: official building footprints and recorded heights. Trees, terrain and LiDAR are not available in this import. Missing data does not mean the site is clear.
locationAddressObjects: To switch sites, remove planning objects, IFC overlays, saved measurements and the project extent and save first. Loading the new address replaces reference layers and clears LiDAR; notes and source files are kept.
locationDetectedTreesHint: Inferred from the Berlin LiDAR survey 2021 (leaf-off), outside cadastre trees and building footprints. Unreviewed; position, height and crown are approximate.
locationDetectedTreesBusy: Detecting trees from the LiDAR survey. This background job may take several minutes; you can leave and return.
locationDetectedTreeHint: Inferred from the 2021 Berlin LiDAR survey, not from the official tree cadastre. Position, height and crown diameter are approximate, species is unknown, and trees removed or planted since 2021 are not reflected. Check on site before relying on it.
publicDataUnreviewed: Projects keep their pinned releases. A recent retrieval does not mean a recent survey or approved evidence.
publicDataDisabled: The public data service is disabled. Your saved context is retained; status checks and refresh are unavailable.
publicDataStatusFailed: Import status could not be loaded. Your saved context is unchanged. Try checking again.
publicDataMissing: Some pinned releases could not be found. Refresh is unavailable; your saved context is retained.
publicDataLiveSource: Open live source query (not archived evidence)
publicDataRetained: The latest source check failed. The last published release is retained.
publicDataRefreshing: Refreshing project context. The existing context remains visible until the job finishes; you can close this panel.
publicDataRefreshFailed: Context refresh failed. The previous context, planning objects and notes are retained. You can retry.
publicDataConfirm: Replace this project's building and tree context with the latest published releases available when the job runs? Planning objects, notes and LiDAR stay unchanged. This does not approve evidence; check your planning against the new context.
locationConflict: This scene changed elsewhere. Your edits are retained. Reload the saved scene before applying them again.
locationIfcHint: IFC geometry is converted to metres, centred and grounded for manual placement. Alignment is unverified. This is a model overlay, not a BIM authoring tool.
locationFitConstructionHint: Fit visible planning geometry, otherwise the source-linked project extent or the address point
locationProjectExtentHint: Dashed outline interpreted from the source plan. Not surveyed geometry or a calculation reference.
locationSelectHint: Select an object in the viewport or scene tree to inspect it.
locationControls: Drag to pan · Ctrl/⌥ + drag or right-drag to orbit · Scroll to zoom · V select · M measure · A align · T/3/S/U views · F frame
locationPlaceHint: Click the viewport to place the selected object in X/Z. Its base elevation stays unchanged.
locationMeasureHint: Measure any surfaces, including neighboring buildings. Empty space uses the flat ground reference. Not a survey; Esc clears.
locationMeasureFirst: Pick the first point on the model or map.
locationMeasureSecond: Pick the second point; a third click starts a new measurement.
locationMeasureSnap: Snap to building / plan corners (1 m)
locationMeasurementsEmpty: Measure two points to save a distance here.
locationMeasurementExample: e.g. distance to the neighboring building
locationMeasurementSceneDirty: Saving or removing this measurement also saves your pending scene edits.
locationTreeStyleHint: Illustrative only · Measure uses schematic trees.
locationTreeIllustrationHint: Recorded height and crown diameter; illustrative foliage and trunk shapes, not surveyed branches. Trees missing dimensions stay schematic. Measure returns to schematic trees. Not suitable for clearance assessment.
locationTreeHint: Discs show recorded crown diameter and total height only. Crown underside, trunk width and branch geometry are unknown. This is not a tree clearance model.
locationBuildingHint: Footprint extruded to recorded ridge height; roof shape is not modelled. Flat reference ground, not surveyed terrain.
locationVehicleHint: Example dimensions only: confirm the actual vehicle, mirrors, equipment, outriggers, working space and approach path. A parked envelope is not a fire-access assessment.
locationLighting: Illustrative lighting · not a sun study
locationSafety: 2021 survey + sampled points cannot establish present-day clearance. No points in an envelope does not mean it is clear. Verify branches, terrain and fire-service requirements on site.
locationCloudHint: First load may take several minutes. A durable background job crops the original survey tile; you can leave and return.
locationOrigin: X east · Y up · Z south · metres
locationNotesHint: Keep jour-fixe decisions, open questions and source references here. Notes do not generate or approve geometry. Use pins for spatial questions and massing boxes for explicitly assumed alternatives.
locationWebgl: The 3D viewport could not start. WebGL2 is required; try another browser or enable hardware acceleration.
tokenLimitQuestion: Token limit exceeded. Do you want to set a higher limit of {tokens}?
tokenLimitDescribe: Describe what Richtfest should do differently
tokenLimitDescribePrompt: Please change the approach as follows:
tokenLimitDeclined: Limit unchanged. No run was started.
tokenLimitScope: Only new runs use this workspace setting. Ordinary Retry reuses the failed run’s snapshot. Active and historical runs are unchanged.
tokenLimitMaximum: The configured output-token cap is {tokens}, already at the workspace maximum. The report section stopped; no completed report was produced. Split the report into smaller sections or check output and character-limit settings. The model’s own limits still apply. No setting was changed.
tokenLimitCaveat: Double only this role’s output-token limit, capped at 128,000. Longer outputs may cost more and take longer; the model’s own limits still apply. Provider, model, reasoning and all other preset settings stay unchanged.
tokenLimitPermission: Workspace administration access is required to change this setting.
tokenLimitStale: This role is unconfigured, at its maximum, or has changed since the failed run. No change is available here. Check workspace settings.
tokenLimitError: Could not load or save the token limit. Try again.
tokenLimitSuccess: Limit saved for new runs. No run was started. Ordinary Retry still uses the original snapshot.
runEvaluationRubric: 1 — Poor · 2 — Fair · 3 — Good · 4 — Very good · 5 — Excellent
runExecutionUsageMissing: Provider usage was not reported; totals may be incomplete.
runExecutionUsagePending: Provider usage is pending; totals are not final.
helpNoPermission: You do not have permission to run the assistant.
helpUnconfigured: The help assistant is not connected yet.
helpManualAvailable: You can still file bugs and feature requests manually.
helpStart: Ask about Richtfest, request a feature, or report a bug.
helpRetryHint: Messages may already be saved. Retry the same request safely, or start a new message.
helpExplicitSubmit: Review and edit the details. No report is filed until you submit it.
helpReportRetryHint: Retry uses the same report ID to avoid duplicates. Close and reopen to edit a new submission.
helpFailed: The assistant could not reply. Your message is saved; send a new message to try again.
workspaceWorkNoSources: Checking the assignment and evidence gaps; no readable sources available
workspaceWorkFindingsSaved: Saved findings from this source batch
workspaceWorkReviewing: Comparing specialist findings and drafting the recommendation
workspaceWorkIndependent: Checking the draft against the source evidence
workspaceWorkCheckingEditorial: Checking that the edit preserves the evidence
workspaceActivityWaiting: Working; recorded steps will appear here.
workspaceFailureSummaryLimit: The generated summary exceeded the character limit
workspaceFailureSummaryAction: Ask for a shorter summary, or increase Summary characters in Agent model settings and start a new run. This is not a token limit.
workspaceFailureSchema: The generated response failed field validation. Clarify the requested fields or narrow the task before retrying. No output was approved.
workspaceFailureEditorial: The editorial check could not confirm that the edit preserves the evidence. No report was published. Retry run revises the edit using saved feedback; the original draft is retained.
workspaceFailureRateLimit: The provider rejected this call with HTTP 429: a rate limit or exhausted quota. Saved progress is retained.
workspaceFailureThrottled: The provider reported a rate limit. Saved progress is retained.
workspaceFailureQuota: The provider reported exhausted quota or a billing limit. Check provider billing before retrying.
workspaceFailureTruncated: The report section stopped at the provider’s output length limit. No completed report was produced. Split the report into smaller sections or check output-token limits before starting a new run.
workspaceFailureIncomplete: The agent marked a report section as incomplete, so no completed report was produced. Narrow the request or check output limits before starting a new run. Provider token truncation was not confirmed.
workspaceFailureContentLimit: Report content exceeded a character limit
workspaceFailureContentAction: No completed report was produced. Acoustic report sections now use soft character targets: choose Retry run to resume saved work after an older character-limit failure. Other report formats still enforce character limits. This is not a token limit.
workspaceActivityPlanned: Plan prepared and specialist tasks assigned
workspaceActivityIndependentReviewStarte: Independent reviewer checking the prepared result
workspaceActivityIndependentReviewComple: Independent review completed; result remains ready for human review
workspaceActivityFailed: Execution failed; check the provider connection and retry
workspaceRunNoSpecificReason: No specific failure reason was recorded for this run.
workspaceRunFailedNoReason: Execution failed without a recorded reason.
workspaceRunCancelledNoReason: Run was cancelled without a recorded reason.
workspaceRunCategoryProvider: The provider call could not complete. Check the provider connection and retry.
workspaceRunCategoryBudget: Execution paused before another paid call: the spend or retry allowance was reached, or usage/pricing is unknown. Preview saved progress and authorize an additional allowance to resume.
workspaceRunCategoryOutcomeUnknown: The previous worker lost ownership with an unfinished provider attempt. Its outcome and charges may be unknown. No automatic replacement call was started; review saved progress before authorizing recovery.
workspaceRunCategoryTimeout: The provider call exceeded its time limit. Retry run reuses available saved progress with the original settings. Use Run again to start fresh with current model settings.
workspaceRunCategoryPermission: A required permission is unavailable. Ask an administrator for access and retry.
workspaceRunCategoryValidation: The run returned unsupported or invalid output. Review the inputs and retry.
workspaceRunCategorySource: Required project source content is unavailable. Restore or select readable sources and retry.
workspaceRunCategoryProject: The project is unavailable. Confirm project access and retry.
workspaceRunCategoryCancellation: The run was cancelled before output could be approved.
workspaceRunCategoryExecution: The run stopped unexpectedly before output could be approved. Retry the run.
workspaceRunChildCauseSupervisorFailed: Supervisor failed. Retry the supervisor run.
workspaceRunChildCauseSupervisorCancelle: Supervisor was cancelled. Retry the supervisor run.
workspaceRunChildCauseSupervisorSteered: Supervisor received new instructions. Retry the supervisor run.
workspaceRunReviewRejected: Output was rejected during human review. Retry the run to submit new output.
workspaceRunNoResponse: The agent run failed before producing a response.
workspaceActivityCalculationUnavailable: No validated calculation tool is available

noCustomers: No customers yet. Create the first customer to connect people and projects.
noWork: No assigned work. Start a conversation in a project to move a decision forward.
noReview: Nothing awaiting review. Source-linked drafts will appear here before they become shared knowledge.

deleteProjectSourcesInUse: Some project sources are still referenced by another project or company knowledge. Remove those references before deleting the project.

noKnowledge: No reviewed knowledge yet. Add a source-linked draft, then approve it after review.
agentUnavailable: Agent execution is not configured. Connect a model provider and an approved planning tool before running analysis.
agentBoundary: Agent execution is separate from manual findings. No calculation or regulatory compliance is implied by a draft.
loginTitle: A clear foundation for every project.
loginDescription: Bring your customers, source documents, and planning decisions into one shared workspace.
devNote: This optional shortcut is available only in an enabled development environment. It is not a production sign-in method.
devIdentityEmpty: No development identities are available yet. Ask the developer who started this environment to seed one.
devIdentityLoadError: Development identities could not be loaded. Your normal sign-in methods are still available.
devLoginFailed: The development sign-in could not be completed. Your normal sign-in methods are still available.
loginUnavailable: Sign-in is not configured for this environment. Ask the workspace administrator to enable an authentication provider.
sourceRequired: Register a source before creating a knowledge draft.
accessNote: Workspace roles determine which records and actions each person can access.
reviewNote: Check the finding against its linked source before approving it for the team.
sessionExpired: Your session has expired. Sign in again.
notFound: This page could not be found.
aiConnectionsDescription: Manage credentials and choose the provider and model presets used by agent work.
personalCredentialHint: Your personal credential takes priority for the selected provider. Only you can replace or remove it.
workspaceCredentialHint: The workspace credential is used for the selected provider when a personal credential is not configured.
activeProviderHint: Workspace administrators choose the provider that runs agent work. Configure its model and effort presets in Agent model settings. A personal credential overrides the workspace credential for the selected provider.
workspaceAdminOnly: Only workspace administrators can change the shared credential.
apiKeyHint: The key is encrypted on the server and will never be shown again.
apiKeyReplaceHint: A saved key is shown masked. Enter a new key to replace it.
removeCredentialConfirm: Remove this credential? Requests will use the remaining credential, if available.
encryptionMissing: Credential storage is unavailable. An administrator must configure server-side encryption before keys can be saved.
noProviderCall: Saving credentials does not contact the provider or run an agent.
supervisorPresetsDisabled: Optional supervisor delegation is disabled. These model settings still apply to direct agent work.
supervisorAdminOnly: Only workspace administrators can change supervisor presets.
supervisorPresetUnavailable: No model settings are available for this provider.
resetSupervisorPreset: Reset model settings to vendor default
supervisorReportWriterDescription: Optional override for report sections, editorial writing and consolidation only. When disabled, the supervisor settings are used unchanged. Outline, checks, independent review and ordinary supervisor calls are not affected. Enabling copies the supervisor settings for adjustment.
supervisorOptionalSpecialistsDescription: Enable specialists for this provider and effort preset. Disabled specialists are not delegated work. Enabling copies the configured reviewer model; you can then adjust it. Additional model calls may be used.
supervisorIndependentReviewDescription: Opt in to a separate reviewer run after the supervisor prepares its result. Off by default; enabling it may use additional model calls.
supervisorManagedChild: Managed by the supervisor. Use the parent run to steer or cancel this assignment.
supervisorResponseLimitsDescription: Shared by supervisor and specialists in this effort preset. Character limits are separate from each model’s output-token budget. The document character limit applies to one response, not an acoustic report assembled from sections. The timeout applies to each model call.
supervisorLimitsNewRuns: Changes apply to new runs. Existing runs and ordinary retries keep their original settings. Higher limits can increase duration and cost.
supervisorLimitsInvalid: Enter whole numbers within the displayed ranges before saving.
agentToolsUnavailable: Provider credentials do not enable planning tools. Agent execution is unavailable until an approved tool is configured.
signInLoadFailed: Sign-in could not load. The app may have updated. Reload the app and try again.
accountSettingsCodeLoadFailed: Account security could not load. The app may have updated or the connection was interrupted. Reload the app to continue; no security changes were made.
accountSettingsLoadFailed: Some account security details could not load. Check your connection and try again.
magicLinkRequested: If this email has access, a sign-in link is on its way.
inviteOnlyHint: This workspace is invitation-only. Ask your administrator for access.
deliveryConfigured: Email delivery is configured. Check your inbox for eligible requests.
deliveryPreview: Local email preview is enabled. No external email is sent in this environment.
deliveryUnconfigured: Email delivery is not configured. The administrator must connect an email provider before links can be delivered.
deliveryUnknown: The server has not confirmed email delivery readiness.
emailInvitationHint: The invitation is delivered by the configured email service. No private sign-in link is displayed here.
developmentOutboxHint: Local email previews are available only to authorized administrators in this development environment. No external email is sent.
passwordSignInHint: Password sign-in is available for accounts that have enrolled one.
passkeyFailed: Passkey sign-in could not be completed. Use an email link or password instead.
passkeyPrompt: Use the passkey saved on your device or security key.
passkeyUnavailable: Passkeys require a supported browser and a secure connection. Use an email link on this device.
accountSettingsDescription: Manage personal preferences and sign-in methods.
securityDescription: Choose how you sign in after your first invitation.
enrollmentHint: Your invitation establishes your account. Add a password or passkey for future sign-ins; email links remain available for recovery.
freshSessionRequired: Password enrollment requires a recently verified email session and no existing password. Sign in using a fresh email link if needed.
passwordSaved: Password saved. You can use it for future sign-ins.
sessionListFreshSessionRequired: Sign in again to view and manage your active sessions.
removePasskeyHint: This passkey will no longer sign you in. Your other sign-in methods remain available.
deleteFileWarning: Permanently delete this file, all its versions and extracted data? Existing source links will no longer work. Conversations and reports are kept. This cannot be undone.
uploadFinished: Upload finished. Review any files that could not be uploaded, then close this dialog.
uploadPlanAnalysisDescription: Richtfest is reading the PDF, identifying floor-plan pages and preparing unreviewed room and construction geometry. You can leave this dialog; progress is saved.
analyticsAverageScope: One run includes its coordinator and all subagents. The average covers only inactive runs with complete input and output usage; totals include recorded usage from all runs, across every page.
analyticsModelScope: Models reflect saved usage only; calls without usage may not be attributable to a model. Total tokens = input + output. Reasoning and cached input are subsets, not additional tokens.
analyticsScope: Estimated USD costs include the coordinator and all subagents, with reported retries counted once. Tokens reflect reported usage; active runs show costs so far. This is not a provider bill and excludes title generation, source processing and hosting.
analyticsLoadError: Costs could not be loaded. Refresh costs to try again; any displayed values are from the last successful load.
analyticsEmpty: No agent runs in this project yet.
analyticsIncomplete: The full cost is unknown. Only recorded, priced usage is shown; missing data is never treated as zero.
analyticsLegacy: Each row contains only that agent's own calls, without double-counting descendants. Historical usage stays with the agent it was recorded against. Reasoning is part of output tokens; cached input is part of input tokens.
agentRunWaitingForWorker: Waiting for the worker to start
agentRunAwaitingProgress: Run started; waiting for its first progress update
noAgentRuns: No agent work assigned for this project.
agentGoalHint: Assign a goal with source versions. The server records the actual execution state; unavailable tools will not produce a result.
approvalBoundary: Review the result and its sources before approving. Approval records your decision; it does not authorize an unlisted external action or certify regulatory compliance.
offboardWarning: This removes workspace access and revokes this member’s sessions. Existing project records and attribution are retained.
cancelInvitationWarning: The recipient will no longer be able to use this pending invitation.
workspaceInvalidUI: This generated view could not be validated.
workspaceExportPdfHint: Download this exact revision as a PDF
workspaceExportNoSourceRefs: No source references recorded for this revision.
workspaceExactVersion: Choose the exact revision to review or annotate. Existing links keep their original revision.
workspaceNoThreadArtifacts: No artifacts in this thread yet.
workspaceCommentRunHint: Select document text to quote it. Comments stay with this revision and are shared in its thread. Continue in chat to ask the agent to revise; commenting does not start a run.
workspaceStart: Start a shared conversation to discuss this project and its sources.
workspaceNoExecution: Agent replies are unavailable. Open Settings to connect the selected inference provider and configure its model. You can still save messages in this conversation.
workspaceMessageSavedNoReply: Your message was saved, but the agent could not reply.
runRecoveryEditorialChecked: An edited draft is saved; its evidence-preservation check passed. This is not human approval.
runRecoveryEditorialUnchecked: An edited draft is saved; preservation of the evidence has not been confirmed. It is not an approved report.
runRecoveryReuse: The original model and settings are retained. Unfinished work and reviews will run. Saved work is reused only if inputs are unchanged; otherwise affected work must run again.

Element values come from the component catalogues; enter what the building model lacks.
interiorElevatedLevel: Elevated sound insulation is agreed for this building. Only the minimum requirements are checked here.
interiorUnavailablePack: Interior sound insulation is not configured on this server.
interiorUnavailablePlan: No placed floor plan with walls yet. Trace the plan in the building model first.
interiorNoWalls: No wall with the role apartment partition, corridor or stairwell wall between two rooms yet. Set wall roles in the building model.
interiorNoCeilings: No ceiling with a requirement over traced rooms yet.
interiorNoElements: No elements in the checks yet.
interiorCreateHint: Writes the draft with every check and its open inputs for you to review and sign.
interiorCreateNone: Available once one wall or ceiling has complete inputs.
interiorNoDoors: No door in a stairwell or corridor wall yet. Add the entrance doors below.
interiorGapNoRequirement: no requirement for this element type
interiorGapFlankingMissing: flanking wall at the {edge} (trace it in the building model)
interiorReasonLightweight: lightweight separating element without a catalogue row
interiorUnsupportedMixed: Junction of a lightweight and a massive flanking wall (not covered)
interiorLimitMinimum: Checks the DIN 4109-1 minimum requirements; elevated sound insulation is not checked.
interiorLimitJunctions: Junctions are rigid T or cross junctions taken from the plan: a cross junction where the separating wall continues in line past the flanking wall or onto the next storey, and for ceilings at inner walls. Corner junctions, elastic interlayers and perforated exterior walls with butt joints are not corrected; flanking walls of different mass on the two sides use their mean mass.
interiorLimitLinings: One-sided linings on separating walls are placed on the less favourable side; on inner flanking walls they count only where they worsen.
interiorLimitDoors: Doors and walls with doors are not checked.
interiorLimitFloor: The slab under a storey is not in the model; it is taken to equal the ceiling above.
interiorLimitWallsAbove: Ceilings: where the storey above has no traced wall standing on a wall below (always for the top storey), that wall is taken to continue upwards.
interiorLimitImpact: Impact sound into the room below; in other directions (beside, diagonally below) only from the floors of common hallways into neighbouring protected rooms.
proofCatalogueGlazingUnreadable: glazing not readable, write it as 6/16/4
proofCatalogueBelowCatalogue: below the window catalogue, needs a tested value
proofGlazingHint: Panes and cavities in mm, e.g. 6/16/4. Without an installed Rw, the window catalogue suggests one from it.
noiseStepNextLevels: Open the facade levels calculated from these sources
proofAddOpeningTitle: Add window, door or small element
proofCatalogueHint: For walls and windows without Rw; you confirm each suggestion.

interiorElevatedChecked: Elevated sound insulation is agreed for this building; the checks use the DIN 4109-5 requirements.
interiorGapStairWall: a stairwell wall to a protected room (wall role and room use)
interiorGapDoorCriteria: tested Rw (leaf and seals do not cover this requirement)
